introduction: Rhode Island UI provides temporary income after qualifying job loss. DLT reviews wages, separation and continuing eligibility.
description: Rhode Island UI provides temporary income after qualifying job loss. DLT reviews wages, separation and continuing eligibility.

sections.who: You must have enough qualifying wages and meet job-separation and weekly requirements. Explain all relevant employment circumstances accurately.
sections.get: Approved payments provide temporary support. Filing a claim and requesting weekly payments are separate actions.
sections.docs:
• Identity and contact information.
  • Employer, employment dates and wage records.
  • The separation reason and requested supporting evidence.
sections.apply:
1. Start the claim

    Use the UI Online link on DLT Unemployment Insurance.

  2. Answer follow-up requests

    Complete identity checks and any fact-finding questionnaire.

  3. Request payments

    Follow the state’s weekly payment instructions and report earnings accurately.
sections.after: Read decisions and appeal instructions. If account access or claim filing fails, use the UI Help Form linked by DLT.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using DLT unemployment; DLT application instructions. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Is filing the initial claim enough?
No. Follow the separate payment-request instructions.
DLT reviews wages and separation circumstances.
Where do I ask about technical problems?
Use the UI Help Form linked on the state UI page.
What if a form looks unreadable?
Check the saved file before uploading; DLT warns some iPhone PDFs have overlapping text.
